column2:
background(n.)背景、背景經歷
(無詞性變化)
cultural background 文化背景
background music 背景音樂
She comes from a diverse cultural background with rich traditions.
(她來自一個擁有豐富傳統的多元文化背景。)
Soft background music was playing while we enjoyed our dinner.
(在我們享用晚餐時，放著柔和的背景音樂。)

bacon(n.)培根
(無詞性變化)
crispy bacon 酥脆培根
bacon and eggs 培根煎蛋
He ordered a plate of crispy bacon and scrambled eggs for breakfast.
(他早餐點了一盤酥脆培根和炒蛋。)
The delicious smell of frying bacon filled the entire kitchen.
(煎培根的美味香氣瀰漫了整間廚房。)

bacteria(n.)細菌 (複數)
bacterium(n.)細菌 (單數)
bacterial(adj.)細菌的
harmful bacteria 有害細菌
grow bacteria 滋生細菌
Washing your hands frequently with soap helps kill harmful bacteria.
(常用肥皂洗手有助於殺死有害細菌。)
Warm and humid conditions allow bacteria to multiply rapidly.
(溫暖潮濕的環境會讓細菌迅速滋生。)

badly(adv.)嚴重地、非常
bad(adj.)壞的、差的
badly hurt 受傷嚴重
badly needed 迫切需要
Several passengers were badly injured in the highway car accident.
(幾名乘客在高速公路車禍中嚴重受傷。)
Clean drinking water is badly needed in the disaster area.
(災區迫切需要乾淨的飲用水。)

baggage(n.)行李
(無詞性變化)
baggage claim 行李提領處
excess baggage 超重行李
Passengers can collect their suitcases at the baggage claim area.
(旅客可以在行李提領處領取他們的行李箱。)
You will have to pay an extra fee if you have excess baggage.
(如果你的行李超重，將必須支付額外費用。)

bait(n./v.)餌、誘餌、引誘
(無詞性變化)
fishing bait 魚餌
take the bait 上當、咬餌
He placed a fresh earthworm on the hook as fishing bait.
(他把一條新鮮的蚯蚓鉤在魚鉤上當作魚餌。)
The detective laid a trap and waited for the criminal to take the bait.
(刑警設下陷阱，等待罪犯上當咬餌。)

bamboo(n.)竹子
(無詞性變化)
bamboo forest 竹林
bamboo shoots 竹筍
Giant pandas feed almost exclusively on fresh green bamboo.
(大貓熊幾乎完全以新鮮翠綠的竹子為食。)
Walking through the peaceful bamboo forest brought calmness to her mind.
(漫步在寧靜的竹林中讓她的心情平靜下來。)

bang(n./v.)砰擊、猛擊、砰的一聲
(無詞性變化)
big bang 宇宙大爆炸、巨響
bang on the door 猛敲門
The wooden door closed with a loud bang due to the strong wind.
(因為強風，木門發出砰的一聲巨響關上了。)
He started to bang on the locked door asking for help.
(他開始用力猛敲反鎖的門大聲求救。)

banker(n.)銀行家、銀行主管
bank(n./v.)銀行、存款
banking(n.)銀行業
investment banker 投資銀行家
successful banker 成功的銀行家
After graduating from business school, he became a successful investment banker.
(商學院畢業後，他成了一名成功的投資銀行家。)
The banker carefully reviewed the loan application before approving it.
(銀行經理在批准貸款申請前仔細地進行了審查。)

bare(adj.)赤裸的、光禿禿的
barely(adv.)勉強、幾乎不
barefoot(adj./adv.)赤腳的
bare feet 赤腳
bare hands 赤手空拳
The children enjoyed running on the sandy beach with bare feet.
(孩子們喜歡赤腳在沙灘上奔跑。)
He managed to climb up the rocky cliff with his bare hands.
(他僅憑赤手空拳就爬上了那座陡峭的岩壁。)

barely(adv.)勉強、幾乎不
bare(adj.)赤裸的
barely audible 幾乎聽不見
barely escape 險些逃脫
Her voice was trembling and barely audible in the crowded room.
(在擁擠的房間裡，她的聲音顫抖著，幾乎聽不見。)
The driver barely escaped being hit by the falling tree branch.
(司機差一點就被掉落的樹枝砸中，險象環生。)

barn(n.)穀倉、牲口棚
(無詞性變化)
red barn 紅色穀倉
barn owl 倉鴞
The farmer stored bales of dry hay inside the large wooden barn.
(農夫把一捆捆乾燥的乾草存放在大型木造穀倉裡。)
During the heavy rainstorm, horses were led safely into the barn.
(暴風雨期間，馬匹被安全地牽進了牲口棚裡。)

barrel(n.)木桶、大圓桶、槍管
(無詞性變化)
oil barrel 油桶
wooden barrel 木桶
Traditional wine is aged inside oak barrels to enhance its flavor.
(傳統葡萄酒在橡木桶中陳釀以增添其風味。)
The factory produces thousands of barrels of refined oil every day.
(這家工廠每天生產數千桶精煉石油。)

basement(n.)地下室
base(n./v.)基礎、基於
basement parking 地下停車場
dark basement 昏暗的地下室
They converted their spacious basement into a home theater.
(他們把寬敞的地下室改造成了家庭劇院。)
During the fierce tornado warning, the family took shelter in the basement.
(在強烈的龍捲風警報期間，全家人在地下室躲避。)

bay(n.)海灣
(無詞性變化)
San Francisco Bay 舊金山灣
keep at bay 牽制、阻擋
Sailboats were drifting peacefully across the blue water of the bay.
(帆船在海灣湛藍的水面上平靜地漂流。)
Eating healthy food helps keep seasonal colds and illness at bay.
(健康飲食有助於預防季節性感冒與疾病。)

bead(n.)珠子、小水滴
beaded(adj.)飾有珠子的
glass bead 玻璃珠
beads of sweat 汗珠
She strung colorful glass beads together to make a pretty necklace.
(她把五顏六色的玻璃珠串在一起做成一條漂亮的項鍊。)
Beads of sweat formed on his forehead after the strenuous marathon.
(跑完艱苦的馬拉松後，他的額頭上冒出了汗珠。)

beam(n./v.)光線、橫梁、眉開眼笑
(無詞性變化)
beam of light 一束光線
beam with joy 喜形於色
A bright beam of sunlight shone through the gaps in the window curtains.
(一道耀眼的陽光穿透窗簾縫隙照射進來。)
The proud mother beamed with joy when she saw her daughter graduate.
(當看見女兒畢業時，驕傲的母親喜笑顏開。)

beast(n.)野獸
beastly(adj.)殘暴的、討厭的
wild beast 猛獸
Beauty and the Beast 美女與野獸
The ancient forest was believed to be inhabited by mythical wild beasts.
(這片古老的森林傳說中棲息著神話中的猛獸。)
The famous fairy tale Beauty and the Beast carries a heartwarming message.
(著名的童話《美女與野獸》傳達了溫暖人心的啟示。)

beetle(n.)甲蟲
(無詞性變化)
stag beetle 鍬形蟲
rhinoceros beetle 獨角仙
The little boy loves observing the shiny shell of the rhinoceros beetle.
(小男孩非常喜歡觀察獨角仙有光澤的外殼。)
Many species of beetles play an important role in forest ecosystems.
(許多種甲蟲在森林生態系中扮演著重要的角色。)

beneath(prep./adv.)在...之下、在下方
(無詞性變化)
beneath the surface 在表面之下
beneath the trees 在樹蔭下
Much of the huge iceberg remains hidden beneath the ocean surface.
(巨大的冰山大部分隱藏在海洋表面之下。)
We sat on the bench beneath the shady trees to escape the afternoon heat.
(我們坐在綠樹成蔭的長椅下避暑。)

benefit(n./v.)利益、好處、受惠
beneficial(adj.)有益的
beneficiary(n.)受益人
health benefits 健康益處
benefit from 從...中獲益
Regular physical exercise offers numerous long-term health benefits.
(規律的體能鍛鍊帶來許多長期的健康益處。)
Students will greatly benefit from participating in practical internship programs.
(學生將從參與實習計畫中大幅獲益。)

berry(n.)漿果、莓果
(無詞性變化)
pick berries 採莓果
wild berries 野生漿果
The hikers picked wild berries along the sunny mountain trail.
(登山客沿著陽光明媚的山徑採摘野生莓果。)
Strawberries and blueberries are rich in antioxidants and vitamins.
(草莓和藍莓富含抗氧化劑與維生素。)

besides(prep./adv.)除...之外、此外
beside(prep.)在...旁邊
besides that 除此之外
who else besides 除...之外還有誰
Besides English, she can speak fluent French and conversational Japanese.
(除了英語之外，她還能說流利的法語和基礎日語。)
I don't really want to go out tonight; besides, it is starting to rain.
(我今晚不是很想出門；此外，天也開始下雨了。)

bet(v./n.)打賭、下注、把握的事
(無詞性變化)
place a bet 下注
I bet 我敢肯定、我敢打賭
He placed a small bet on his favorite football team in the final.
(他在決賽中給自己最喜歡的足球隊下了一筆小注。)
I bet that you will pass the final English exam with flying colors.
(我敢肯定你一定會以優異的成績通過英文期末考。)

bind(v.)綑綁、束縛、約束
binding(adj./n.)有約束力的、裝訂
bind together 連結在一起
legally binding 具法律約束力的
Shared cultural values and mutual respect bind the community together.
(共同的文化價值觀與相互尊重將整個社區連結在一起。)
Both parties signed the contract, making it a legally binding agreement.
(雙方均簽署了合約，使其成為具法律約束力的協議。)

bitter(adj.)苦的、嚴寒的、痛苦怨恨的
bitterly(adv.)痛苦地、極其
bitterness(n.)苦味、怨恨
bitter taste 苦味
bitter cold 刺骨嚴寒
Dark chocolate usually has a rich aroma and a slightly bitter taste.
(黑巧克力通常具有濃郁的香氣和微苦的滋味。)
The soldiers marched forward through the bitter cold wind and heavy snow.
(士兵們冒著刺骨的寒風與大雪向前行軍。)

bleed(v.)流血
blood(n.)血液
bloody(adj.)血腥的
bleed heavily 大量流血
nosebleed(n.)流鼻血
Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth if it starts to bleed.
(如果傷口開始流血，請用乾淨的布用力壓住止血。)
The deep paper cut on his finger bled for several minutes.
(他手指上被紙張劃出的深傷口流了好幾分鐘的血。)

bless(v.)祝福、保佑
blessing(n.)祝福、幸事
blessed(adj.)有福的
God bless you 上帝保佑你
blessed with 幸運享有
The priest raised his hands to bless the newly married couple.
(神父舉起雙手為這對新婚夫婦祈福。)
She feels truly blessed with good health and supportive friends.
(她覺得自己非常幸運，享有健康的體魄和支持她的朋友。)

bloody(adj.)血腥的、流血的
blood(n.)血液
bleed(v.)流血
bloody battle 慘烈的血戰
bloody nose 流鼻血
The historic movie portrayed the horrors of the bloody battle realistically.
(這部歷史電影寫實地描繪了血腥戰役的殘酷面貌。)
He got a bloody nose after accidentally running into the glass door.
(他不小心撞上玻璃門後流了鼻血。)

blouse(n.)女襯衫
(無詞性變化)
silk blouse 絲綢女襯衫
white blouse 白襯衫
She wore a formal white blouse and a dark skirt to the job interview.
(她穿著正式的白襯衫和深色裙子去參加求職面試。)
The delicate silk blouse should be washed by hand with gentle care.
(這件精緻的絲質女襯衫應該用手輕柔清洗。)

bold(adj.)大膽的、勇敢的、粗體的
boldly(adv.)大膽地
boldness(n.)大膽、魄力
bold move 大膽的舉動
in bold font 粗體字
Starting his own technology company at age twenty was a bold move.
(他在二十歲時創立自己的科技公司是一次大膽的嘗試。)
Key terms in the textbook are printed in bold font for easy review.
(教科書中的關鍵術語以粗體字印出以便於複習。)

bomb(n./v.)炸彈、轟炸
bomber(n.)轟炸機
bombing(n.)轟炸事件
time bomb 定時炸彈
bomb threat 炸彈威脅
The security squad was called in to safely defuse the unexploded bomb.
(防爆小組受命前來安全拆除未引爆的炸彈。)
The police evacuated the busy airport terminal after receiving a bomb threat.
(警方接到炸彈威脅後，疏散了繁忙的機場航廈。)

bookcase(n.)書架、書櫃
book(n.)書
case(n.)箱、盒
wooden bookcase 木質書櫃
shelf of a bookcase 書架層板
He organized his extensive novel collection neatly on the wooden bookcase.
(他把數量豐富的小說收藏整齊地排列在木質書櫃上。)
The heavy bookcase took up most of the space along the living room wall.
(沉重的書櫃佔據了客廳牆面大部分的空間。)

boot(n.)靴子、(車輛)後車廂
(無詞性變化)
hiking boots 登山靴
rain boots 雨靴
Make sure to wear sturdy waterproof hiking boots when climbing rough mountains.
(攀登崎嶇山路時務必穿著堅固防水的登山靴。)
The little boy put on his yellow boots to splash happily in muddy puddles.
(小男孩穿上黃色雨靴，開心地在泥水坑裡踏水。)

bore(v./n.)使厭煩、令人討厭的人事物
bored(adj.)感到厭煩的
boring(adj.)無聊的
boredom(n.)無聊
bored to death 無聊得要死
bore tears 令人無聊至極
Long speeches with unnecessary details often bore the restless audience.
(冗長且充斥不必要細節的演講常使坐立難安的聽眾感到厭煩。)
I hope my endless travel stories do not bore you too much.
(我希望我那些講個沒完的旅行故事沒有讓你覺得太無聊。)

bowling(n.)保齡球運動
bowl(v.)打保齡球
bowler(n.)保齡球選手
go bowling 去打保齡球
bowling alley 保齡球館
We decided to go bowling at the recreation center on Saturday evening.
(我們決定週六晚上去育樂中心打保齡球。)
He scored three strikes in a row at the crowded bowling alley.
(他在熱鬧的保齡球館裡連續擊出了三次全倒。)

brake(n./v.)煞車、制動器、煞車減速
(無詞性變化)
hit the brakes 踩煞車
brake suddenly 緊急煞車
The driver hit the brakes hard to avoid hitting the crossing dog.
(司機猛踩煞車以避免撞上過馬路的狗。)
You should regularly check your bicycle brakes before riding downhill.
(下坡前你應該定期檢查腳踏車的煞車功能。)

brass(n.)黃銅、黃銅樂器
(無詞性變化)
brass instrument 銅管樂器
brass band 銅管樂隊
The antique door handle was crafted from shiny polished brass.
(這款復古門把是由光澤閃亮的拋光黃銅製成的。)
Trumpets and trombones belong to the brass section of the orchestra.
(小號和長號屬於管弦樂團中的銅管樂器組。)

bravery(n.)英勇、勇氣
brave(adj.)勇敢的
bravely(adv.)英勇地
medal for bravery 英勇勳章
act of bravery 勇敢行徑
The brave firefighter was awarded a medal for extraordinary bravery.
(英勇的消防員因其非凡的勇氣而獲頒勳章。)
Rescuing the drowning child from the rushing river was an inspiring act of bravery.
(從湍急的河流中救起溺水孩童是令人感佩的英勇行徑。)

breast(n.)乳房、胸膛、胸部
(無詞性變化)
breast cancer 乳癌
chicken breast 雞胸肉
Regular medical screenings are essential for early detection of breast cancer.
(定期健康篩檢對於及早發現乳癌至關重要。)
Grilled chicken breast is a popular healthy meal choice for athletes.
(烤雞胸肉是運動員常見且喜愛的健康餐點選擇。)

breath(n.)呼吸、氣息
breathe(v.)呼吸
breathless(adj.)喘不過氣的
take a deep breath 深吸一口氣
out of breath 上氣不接下氣
Take a deep breath and relax before beginning your oral presentation.
(在開始口頭簡報前，深吸一口氣並放鬆身心。)
He was completely out of breath after running up five flights of stairs.
(在跑上五層樓梯後，他喘得完全上氣不接下氣。)

breathe(v.)呼吸、吸入
breath(n.)呼吸
breathing(n.)呼吸
breathe in 吸氣
breathe out 呼氣
It feels wonderful to step outside and breathe the fresh morning air.
(走進戶外大口呼吸清晨的新鮮空氣令人心曠神怡。)
The yoga instructor told the students to breathe in slowly through their nose.
(瑜伽教練囑咐學員用鼻子緩慢地吸氣。)

breeze(n.)微風、輕而易舉的事
breezy(adj.)有微風的、輕快的
gentle breeze 微風
sea breeze 海風
A cool gentle breeze blew across the lake, making the summer heat bearable.
(一陣涼爽的微風拂過湖面，使夏天的炎熱變得好受些。)
Thanks to thorough preparation, the math test was an absolute breeze for him.
(由於準備充足，那場數學考試對他來說完全是輕而易舉。)

brick(n.)磚塊
(無詞性變化)
brick wall 磚牆
red brick 紅磚
The historic cottage was built with solid red bricks over a century ago.
(這座歷史悠久的小屋是一百多年前用堅固的紅磚砌成的。)
He stacked the remaining bricks neatly beside the garage.
(他把剩下的磚塊整齊地堆放在車庫旁邊。)

bride(n.)新娘
bridal(adj.)婚禮的、新娘的
bridegroom(n.)新郎
bride and groom 新娘與新郎
blushing bride 嬌羞幸福的新娘
The smiling bride walked down the church aisle accompanied by her father.
(面帶微笑的新娘在父親的陪伴下走過教堂紅毯。)
Guests cheered enthusiastically as the bride and groom shared their first dance.
(當新娘與新郎共舞第一支舞時，賓客們熱情地歡呼。)

broadcast(n./v.)廣播、播送
broadcaster(n.)廣播員、廣播公司
live broadcast 現場直播
broadcast live 現場播出
The Olympic opening ceremony was broadcast live to millions of viewers worldwide.
(奧運開幕典禮向全球數百萬觀眾進行了現場直播。)
Tune in to the local radio station for the latest weather broadcast.
(請鎖定當地廣播電台以收聽最新的天氣廣播。)

brunch(n.)早午餐
(無詞性變化)
Sunday brunch 週日早午餐
have brunch 吃早午餐
We decided to meet friends for a relaxing Sunday brunch at a cozy café.
(我們決定和朋友在一間溫馨的咖啡館共進悠閒的週日早午餐。)
Brunch typically combines breakfast items like pancakes with savory lunch dishes.
(早午餐通常結合了煎餅等早餐品項與美味的午餐菜色。)

bubble(n./v.)氣泡、水泡、冒泡
bubbly(adj.)起泡的、活潑的
soap bubble 肥皂泡
economic bubble 經濟泡沫
Children had fun blowing colorful soap bubbles in the sunny park.
(孩子們在陽光明媚的公園裡開心地吹著五彩繽紛的肥皂泡。)
Water began to bubble and steam when it reached boiling point.
(水達到沸點時開始冒泡並產生蒸汽。)

bucket(n.)水桶
bucketful(n.)滿滿一桶
bucket list 人生願望清單
a bucket of water 一桶水
Traveling to see the northern lights is at the very top of my bucket list.
(去欣賞北極光位居我人生願望清單的第一位。)
He filled the plastic bucket with warm water to wash the family car.
(他把塑膠水桶裝滿溫水來清洗家裡的汽車。)

bud(n./v.)花蕾、芽、發芽
budding(adj.)萌芽的、有發展潛力的
rose bud 玫瑰花蕾
nip in the bud 防患於未然、扼殺在萌芽階段
In early spring, tiny flower buds begin to appear on the bare branches.
(初春時節，微小的花蕾開始出現在光禿禿的枝頭上。)
Parents and teachers should work together to nip bad behavioral habits in the bud.
(家長和老師應該共同努力，將不良行為習慣防患於未然。)

budget(n./v.)預算、編列預算
budgetary(adj.)預算的
on a budget 預算有限
annual budget 年度預算
Traveling on a tight budget requires careful planning and smart choices.
(在預算吃緊的情況下旅行需要周詳的規劃與明智的選擇。)
The school board approved the annual budget for the upcoming academic year.
(校董會審批了即將到來學年的年度預算。)

buffalo(n.)水牛、野牛
(無詞性變化)
water buffalo 水牛
herd of buffalo 一群野牛
In traditional Taiwanese farming, water buffaloes were indispensable helpers.
(在台灣傳統農業中，水牛是不可或缺的得力幫手。)
A large herd of wild buffalo grazed peacefully across the open grassland.
(一大群野生水牛在遼闊的草原上悠閒吃草。)

buffet(n.)自助餐
(無詞性變化)
buffet dinner 自助晚餐
all-you-can-eat buffet 吃到飽自助餐
The luxury hotel offers a wonderful seafood buffet dinner on weekends.
(這家豪華飯店在週末提供豐盛的海鮮自助晚餐。)
You can help yourself to a wide variety of fresh dishes at the buffet counter.
(你可以在自助餐檯隨意享用各式各樣的新鮮菜餚。)

bulb(n.)電燈泡、球莖
(無詞性變化)
light bulb 電燈泡
plant bulbs 種植球莖
Replacing old incandescent bulbs with LED bulbs saves significant electricity.
(將老舊白熾燈泡更換為 LED 燈泡可大幅節省電力。)
She planted tulip bulbs in the garden before the first winter frost.
(她在入冬第一道霜降前在花園裡種下了鬱金香球莖。)

bull(n.)公牛、看漲行情
bullish(adj.)樂觀的、看漲的
bull market 牛市(股市大漲)
grab the bull by the horns 挺身面對困難
Investors were excited as the stock market entered a strong bull market.
(隨著股市進入強勁的牛市行情，投資者感到興奮不已。)
Instead of avoiding the difficult challenge, she decided to grab the bull by the horns.
(她決定挺身直接面對困難，而不是逃避這項艱鉅的挑戰。)

bullet(n.)子彈、圓形點標記
bulletproof(adj.)防彈的
bullet train 高速火車、子彈列車
bullet point 條列項目符號
Riding the high-speed bullet train between Tokyo and Osaka is extremely convenient.
(搭乘往返東京與大阪的高速子彈列車極為便利。)
Use bullet points in your presentation slides to make key ideas easier to read.
(在簡報投影片中使用條列式圓點標記，能讓重點更加一目了然。)

bump(n./v.)碰撞、腫塊、隆起、撞擊
bumpy(adj.)顛簸的
speed bump 減速丘
bump into 偶遇、巧遇
Drivers are required to slow down before passing over the speed bump.
(駕駛人在駛過減速丘之前必須放慢車速。)
I was surprised to bump into an old middle school classmate at the supermarket.
(我很驚喜在超市巧遇了一位國中老同學。)

bunch(n.)一束、一串、一群
(無詞性變化)
a bunch of flowers 一束花
a bunch of keys 一串鑰匙
He bought a beautiful bunch of fresh red roses for his mother's birthday.
(他買了一束漂亮的鮮紅玫瑰慶祝母親的生日。)
Thanks a bunch for helping me move the heavy furniture into the new room.
(非常感謝你幫我把沉重的家具搬進新房間。)

bundle(n./v.)包裹、一捆、捆綁
(無詞性變化)
bundle up 穿暖和
a bundle of sticks 一捆木棍
Remember to bundle up warmly before going outside into the freezing snowy weather.
(在走入酷寒的大雪天之前，記得多穿點衣服保暖。)
The mail carrier delivered a neat bundle of letters and magazines this morning.
(郵差今天早晨送來了一整捆整齊的信件與雜誌。)

bury(v.)埋葬、埋藏、埋首於
burial(n.)葬禮、埋葬
bury the hatchet 言歸於好、和解
bury oneself in 埋首於、專心於
After a long feud, the two rival families finally decided to bury the hatchet.
(在長期的不和之後，這兩個宿怨家族終於決定冰釋前嫌、言歸於好。)
During exam week, students bury themselves in textbooks and class notes.
(在考試週期間，學生們全身心埋首於教科書與課堂筆記中。)

bush(n.)灌木、矮樹叢
bushy(adj.)茂密的、濃密的
rose bush 玫瑰花叢
beat around the bush 拐彎抹角
A tiny brown bird built its cozy nest deep inside the thick rose bush.
(一隻棕色小鳥在茂密的玫瑰花叢深處築起了溫馨的巢。)
Please stop beating around the bush and tell us directly what happened.
(請別再拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我們到底發生了什麼事。)

buzz(n./v.)嗡嗡聲、蜂鳴、嗡嗡作響、熱議
buzzer(n.)蜂鳴器
buzz of bees 蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲
buzz with excitement 興奮熱絡
The garden was filled with the gentle buzz of honeybees gathering sweet nectar.
(花園裡充滿了採集甜美花蜜的蜜蜂發出的輕柔嗡嗡聲。)
The entire school auditorium was buzzing with excitement before the concert began.
(在音樂會開始前，整個學校禮堂充滿了興奮熱烈的氣氛。)
